pictures.name: SP1-Anandpur-Crowd
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Spring 1699 on the green hills of Anandpur, Punjab. A vast seated crowd of men and women in colorful turbans and head-coverings fills the hillside, festival banners, a large white tent on a raised platform. Far away on the platform, small and seen only from behind, a regal figure in royal blue with a tall turban raises a gleaming sword toward the sky. The crowd is hushed. Gold spring light, deep blue hills.

pictures.name: SP2-One-Man-Stands
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Inside the hushed seated crowd on the Anandpur hillside, one man rises to his feet: Daya Ram, a slim shopkeeper of about thirty in a simple white kurta and white turban, calm and resolute, hands at his sides. People around him look up at him in astonishment. Spring gold light on his face, blue shadows in the crowd.

pictures.name: SP3-The-Tent
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A large closed white tent on a raised platform on the Anandpur hillside, its door flap shut, a soft glow inside. In the foreground, the backs of the waiting crowd, tense and silent, women holding their scarves. Drifting clouds, late gold light. No people visible inside the tent, nothing frightening, just suspense.

pictures.name: SP4-Four-More
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The Anandpur hillside crowd. Four more men rise one after another from different parts of the crowd, each dressed for his trade and region: a sturdy farmer with a plain shawl, a water-carrier with a leather water bag on his shoulder, a cloth printer with dye-stained hands, and a barber with a small cloth kit. Dignified, brave, quiet. Gold light.

pictures.name: SP5-Five-Return
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Five men walk out of the white tent side by side, dressed alike in matching saffron robes and saffron turbans with blue sashes, each holding a sword upright before him, faces calm and radiant, including the slim shopkeeper Daya Ram at the front. Beside them, seen only from behind, a regal figure in royal blue with a tall turban. The crowd rises in wonder. Respectful, glorious gold light.

Close view of a large polished iron-steel bowl of clear water on a low stool, a straight double-edged sword resting across it, a few white sugar sweets beside it.
